  ✗ ERROR  POSTGRES_SSL_NEGOTIATION_FAILED  127.0.0.1:<port>
    The PostgreSQL SSL negotiation did not complete at this endpoint
    svcdoctor sent an SSLRequest because this run required an encrypted channel, and the exchange did not complete. What arrived instead — an answer the protocol does not define, a peer that closed, or a reply that could not be decoded — is recorded on the referenced evidence.
    This does not establish what is at this endpoint. A PostgreSQL server behind something that rewrites its answers and a service that speaks another protocol entirely can produce the same observation, and svcdoctor observed neither.
    The exchange stopped here: nothing was encrypted, and nothing was presented to this endpoint afterwards.
    → Check that this endpoint is the PostgreSQL service this run was meant to reach, and read the referenced evidence for what the exchange observed
